opportunities.title: Gestión Mensajes Entrantes del Sitio
opportunities.description: Tengo un flujo constante de consultas que llegan a través del formulario de contacto de mi sitio web y necesito que cada mensaje termine rápidamente en la bandeja de la persona correcta dentro del equipo. El trabajo consiste en revisar cada entrada, clasificarla según tema o área (soporte, ventas, facturación, etc.) y reenviarla al responsable correspondiente mediante la herramienta que mejor se adapte: puede ser un simple redireccionamiento por correo, la carga en nuestro CRM (HubSpot o Zoho), o la creación de tickets en un help-desk como Zendesk. También necesito que marques los mensajes duplicados o spam y lleves un breve registro de métricas básicas: volumen diario, tiempo promedio de derivación y cualquier incidencia relevante. Al final de cada semana, un reporte en hoja de cálculo o tablero compartido será suficiente para hacer seguimiento. Entrego acceso al buzón vinculado al formulario, lineamientos de clasificación y la lista de contactos internos. A partir de ahí, sólo requiero puntualidad, atención al detalle y comunicación clara si surge alguna consulta que no entre en las categorías definidas.

opportunities.title: eBay UK Dropshipping Store Partner, Commission Only
opportunities.description: Oakridge Retail is a UK-based business launching a new eBay UK store, which will run as a general store across a range of product categories. We're looking for an experienced eBay dropshipping manager to build the store from launch and run its day-to-day operations. Responsibilities: - Research products with strong demand and healthy margins on eBay UK - Source reliable suppliers, preferably UK-based wholesalers with fast delivery - Create optimised listings, including titles, descriptions, item specifics and pricing - Process orders with suppliers and upload tracking promptly - Handle buyer messages, returns and cases professionally - Keep stock levels and pricing up to date so listings stay accurate - Maintain strong seller performance metrics As the account is new, we expect eBay's selling limits to apply at first. We want steady, sustainable growth that keeps the account in good standing, so experience growing new accounts safely is essential. All products must come from legitimate suppliers. Branded or trademarked items and stock bought from other retailers are not permitted. Payment: This role is commission only, at 30% of net profit per month. Net profit is the sale price minus product cost, delivery, eBay fees, promoted listing costs, refunds and returns. Commission is paid monthly through Freelancer.com, based on the store's sales reports. Requirements: - Proven experience managing eBay dropshipping stores, ideally on eBay UK - Strong knowledge of eBay policies, selling limits and performance standards - Experience with listing and order automation tools - Clear communication and regular progress updates When applying, please include evidence of eBay stores you have managed including sales screenshots, dropshipping suppliers you will be using for UK, estimated profit per sale, and your plan for growing a new account over the first three months. Only applicants with verifiable eBay results will be considered.

opportunities.title: Back-Office Reporting Dashboard
opportunities.description: I need a streamlined back-office system whose sole focus is letting me view reports and business data pulled directly from my existing website/online store. The core deliverable is a web-based dashboard that automatically fetches and aggregates live data, then presents it in three clear report sections: • Sales and revenue reports • Customer activity reports • Staff performance reports Key requirements – Secure API or database connection to the current e-commerce platform so the figures stay up-to-date. – Interactive filters for date range, product, staff member, and customer segment. – Export options (CSV and PDF) for each report. – Simple role-based access so managers see all data while staff view only the parts relevant to them. – Clean, responsive UI that works on desktop and tablet. I’m open to proven stacks such as Laravel, Django, Node.js, or similar; what matters most is reliability and clear documentation so I can maintain the system after hand-off. If you have experience turning raw store data into meaningful insights, I’d love to see a quick outline of your approach and any related dashboards you’ve built.

opportunities.title: Boost Google PageSpeed Scores - Shopify Store
opportunities.description: My site needs a solid performance tweak so it can climb higher in Google search results. My website is https://earphoneguy.com The priority is to raise our Google PageSpeed Insights scores for both mobile and desktop. That means: • auditing the current build • removing or deferring render-blocking CSS/JS, optimising images, and setting up smart caching and compression • improving Core Web Vitals—especially LCP, FID, and CLS—until they sit comfortably in the “Good” range When you’re done I’d like a before-and-after report straight from Google PageSpeed Insights plus a short summary of the changes you made so I can maintain them going forward. If anything in the stack (plugins, hosting settings, CDN, etc.) is a bottleneck, flag it and suggest fixes. I am looking for a quick turnaround.

opportunities.description: I need a clean, professional business site whose core feature is an online booking system. Visitors must be able to see available dates and times, choose a slot, and confirm it in real-time. Key expectations • Responsive design that feels intuitive on mobile and desktop. • Clear step-by-step flow for the user: select service → pick date/time → enter contact info → instant confirmation message. • WhatsApp API or approved integration that forwards each reservation with customer name, chosen slot and any notes. • Simple way for me to adjust available time slots and blackout dates without touching code. Hand-off deliverables: finished site on my hosting, admin credentials, and a short walkthrough video so I can update schedule settings myself. If you have a preferred framework or plugin for the booking calendar, mention it; performance and ease of use are my top priorities.

El trabajo consiste en llamar a potenciales distribuidores o mayoristas, identificar al responsable de compras, conseguir sus datos directos y presentarles nuestro catálogo. Idioma materno español o portugués indispensable para lograr una comunicación fluida con los decisores en la región.

opportunities.title: AI Investigative Documentary: The Binance Hack
opportunities.description: Title: AI & Motion Graphics Documentary Editor (Fern / Neo / Lume Style) — Script, VoiceOver & Prompts Ready ($110 USD Fixed) Overview: I am looking for a fast, detail-oriented video editor to handle the visuals, clean 2.5D motion graphics, and sound design for a 15–20 minute investigative YouTube documentary about the October 2026 Binance cryptocurrency heist. Because my budget is $110 USD fixed, I have already completed 100% of the heavy creative prep so you can move quickly without guesswork. WHAT I AM BRINGING (100% Ready on Day 1): 1. Finalized Script & Visual Notes: A complete 15–20 minute documentary script with scene-by-scene cues. 2. Segmented Voiceover: Clean, studio-quality narration already split into numbered chapter files (Cold Open + Acts I–IV) ready to drop onto your timeline. 3. Complete Editor Spec Sheet: Exact hex color codes (#0A0D12 background, #00D2FF cyan, #E63946 crimson), typography rules, audio levels, and clear guidelines. 4. 34 Pre-Written AI Visual Prompts: Scene-by-scene, copy-pasteable prompts built with a single "style-lock" suffix (minimalist 3D isometric diorama, matte clay & dark glass, Blender Cycles aesthetic) so you don't waste time prompt-engineering. WHAT I WANT FROM YOU (Your Deliverables): 1. Cohesive AI Visuals & Subtle Motion: Generate the 34 provided isometric prompts (via Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, etc.) and keep them dynamic using slow camera push-ins, parallax, or subtle AI motion—no static frames sitting still for more than 4–5 seconds. 2. Clean 2.5D Motion Graphics: Minimalist map animations, simple chat/UI popups, data counters, and clean sans-serif text callouts matching the Spec Sheet. 3. Strict Aesthetic Discipline: Follow the Fern / Neo / Lume investigative look. Strictly NO cheesy "hacker in a hoodie" stock footage, NO green Matrix code, NO bright red arrows, and NO meme sound effects. 4. Atmospheric Sound Design: Dark, minimal ambient synth music (Mr. Robot / Social Network vibe), subtle risers, mechanical UI clicks, and clean music dropouts before major hooks—preserving the natural pauses already in the voiceover. HOW TO APPLY: 1. Start your proposal with the word "CYCLES" so I know you read the full brief. 2. Share 1–2 links to documentary, finance, or explainer videos you have edited (ideally showing dark aesthetics, clean typography, or AI-assisted visuals). 3. Let me know which AI tools and editing software (CapCut Pro, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve) you use and your estimated delivery time.

opportunities.title: Custom Two-Storey Home Design
opportunities.description: I have a vacant block that measures 13.741 m wide by 23.822 m deep, and I’m ready to commission a full concept design for a two-storey family residence. The brief is straightforward: • Layout – Ground level must feature a generous open-plan kitchen, dining and living zone that flows to the backyard. – A guest bedroom also sits on this level. – A double garage (covered parking for two cars) is essential and should integrate neatly with the façade. • Upper level – The home should provide at least four bedrooms in total, so plan the remaining bedrooms—including the master suite—upstairs. – Good separation between the master and secondary bedrooms is preferred for privacy. • Accessibility – Please incorporate a compact two-person lift connecting both floors; allow enough wall thickness and headroom for standard residential lift specs. I’m after a cohesive contemporary design that makes the most of the block’s width while respecting local setbacks. Natural light, cross-ventilation, and practical storage solutions are important. If you work in Revit, Archicad, AutoCAD or similar, let me know; I will need editable files plus PDFs. Deliverables 1. Scaled floorplans, sections and elevations 2. A simple 3D massing model or renders for visualisation 3. A brief note on recommended construction materials and structural grid 4. File hand-over in DWG (or RVT/PLA) and PDF Once the concept is approved, there’s potential for further engagement through to detailed drawings, so clarity and buildability in your initial proposal will weigh heavily in my selection. The land is level

opportunities.title: Modelo SolidWorks cfon lisdta personalizada de componentes
opportunities.description: Cuento con planos detallados —incluyen todas las cotas necesarias— y necesito que se transformen en un modelo 3D listo para fabricación en SolidWorks. Cada pieza debe quedar como componente independiente dentro de un ensamblaje maestro, incorporando tolerancias y materiales tal como aparecen en los dibujos. Entrego únicamente los planos; a partir de ellos deberás: • Modelar todas las piezas y el ensamblaje en SolidWorks, respetando dimensiones, materiales y ajustes de fabricación. • Generar la lista de componentes personalizada (BOM) con la información básica de cada parte. • Crear una vista explotada y renderizar las imágenes correspondientes. • Entregar el archivo nativo de SolidWorks (.SLDPRT y .SLDASM) junto con las imágenes de la vista explotada. • Informarme al finalizar cuánto tiempo te tomó modelar cada componente y el total del proyecto. El trabajo se considerará completo cuando el modelo abra sin errores, coincida con los planos en todas sus medidas y la BOM esté perfectamente alineada con los nombres de archivo entregados. Quedo atento a tu propuesta y plazo estimado.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack React/AI Integration
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a seasoned full-stack engineer who can both extend and maintain my private website (React frontend, Node.js backend) while adding a new layer of AI-driven automation. The core goal is to let AI agents pick up routine work that currently ties up my time. Specifically, the agents should be able to ingest two streams of site data and act on them intelligently: • Forms, messages, and support requests • Content, reports, and analytics Once the data is in hand, the agent must decide what action to take—updating records, triggering workflows, or pushing results back to the interface—without breaking existing functionality. You’ll need to wire these capabilities into the current codebase, expose any new endpoints, and keep the overall UX seamless. I handle deployments on a private Git repo and a VPS stack, so your pull requests should be clean, documented, and production-ready. Familiarity with OpenAI APIs, LangChain, or similar toolkits will help you move fast, but I’m open to the stack you’re most productive with as long as it slots smoothly into React and Node. If this blend of feature development, refactoring, and AI integration sounds like your wheelhouse, message me with a brief outline of how you’d approach the first automation task.

opportunities.title: Build B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal wordPress
opportunities.description: WordPress B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal (Phased Build) Project Summary: We are upgrading an existing live WordPress site into a private, gated B2B wholesale ordering portal for a poultry and egg supplier in Southern Africa. Wholesale pricing and ordering must be restricted to verified business buyers, support local currency (NAD / N$) and 15% VAT rules, enable fast bulk ordering, and automate order alerts and back-office workflows across structured phases. All client, business, pricing, and buyer details are strictly confidential. We are looking for quotes broken down clearly by phase so we can review scope, timelines, and milestones. Phase Breakdown: * Phase 1 — Gated B2B Portal, Bulk Ordering & Instant Alerts * Clone the live WordPress site to a private staging environment with zero downtime to the live site. * Build a B2B registration workflow capturing company details, business registration numbers, and VAT/tax IDs, with a manual admin approval step (pending vs. approved) that gates wholesale pricing and checkout. * Configure NAD / N$ currency, 15% VAT calculation, product listings (SKUs, pack sizes, stock status, and minimum order quantities), and a fast spreadsheet/matrix-style bulk order sheet. * Set up Direct Bank Transfer (EFT) checkout, automated order confirmation emails to buyers and internal office/accounts addresses, and real-time mobile/WhatsApp order notifications. * Structure product, customer, and order data cleanly so Phase 2 can plug in without refactoring the core setup. * Phase 2 — Warehouse Operations & Financial Document Automation * Generate consolidated picking and packing lists for warehouse/ground staff (sorted by product type and delivery route/schedule). * Auto-generate itemized driver delivery notes with delivery details and customer sign-off blocks. * Implement clear order status stages (e.g., Pending, Paid, Processing, Packed, Dispatched, Delivered). * Generate tax invoices for accounting and support credit notes (for adjustments such as weight or quantity variances). * Phase 3 — Online Payments & Scaling Enhancements * Integrate online card/local payment gateway options and support refund workflows alongside EFT. * Support future operational scaling (such as standing/recurring orders, catch-weight adjustments, or reorder tracking). How to Quote: Please include: * Separate cost estimates and estimated timelines for Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 (and note if you recommend milestone splits within each phase). * Relevant past work building gated B2B wholesale portals, bulk order forms, order alerts, and fulfillment/invoicing workflows. * Any clarifying questions before we share staging details under confidentiality.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "WordPress B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal (Phased Build) Project Summary: We are upgrading an existing live WordPress site into a private, gated B2B wholesale ordering portal for a poultry and egg supplier in Southern Africa. Wholesale pricing and ordering must be restricted to verified business buyers, support local currency (NAD / N$) and 15% VAT rules, enable fast bulk ordering, and automate order alerts and back-office workflows across structured phases. All client, business, pricing, and buyer details are strictly confidential. We are looking for quotes broken down clearly by phase so we can review scope, timelines, and milestones. Phase Breakdown: * Phase 1 — Gated B2B Portal, Bulk Ordering & Instant Alerts * Clone the live WordPress site to a private staging environment with zero downtime to the live site. * Build a B2B registration workflow capturing company details, business registration numbers, and VAT/tax IDs, with a manual admin approval step (pending vs. approved) that gates wholesale pricing and checkout. * Configure NAD / N$ currency, 15% VAT calculation, product listings (SKUs, pack sizes, stock status, and minimum order quantities), and a fast spreadsheet/matrix-style bulk order sheet. * Set up Direct Bank Transfer (EFT) checkout, automated order confirmation emails to buyers and internal office/accounts addresses, and real-time mobile/WhatsApp order notifications. * Structure product, customer, and order data cleanly so Phase 2 can plug in without refactoring the core setup. * Phase 2 — Warehouse Operations & Financial Document Automation * Generate consolidated picking and packing lists for warehouse/ground staff (sorted by product type and delivery route/schedule). * Auto-generate itemized driver delivery notes with delivery details and customer sign-off blocks. * Implement clear order status stages (e.g., Pending, Paid, Processing, Packed, Dispatched, Delivered). * Generate tax invoices for accounting and support credit notes (for adjustments such as weight or quantity variances). * Phase 3 — Online Payments & Scaling Enhancements * Integrate online card/local payment gateway options and support refund workflows alongside EFT. * Support future operational scaling (such as standing/recurring orders, catch-weight adjustments, or reorder tracking). How to Quote: Please include: * Separate cost estimates and estimated timelines for Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 (and note if you recommend milestone splits within each phase). * Relevant past work building gated B2B wholesale portals, bulk order forms, order alerts, and fulfillment/invoicing workflows. * Any clarifying questions before we share staging details under confidentiality."

opportunities.title: Hybrid Chatbot & Live Support Setup
opportunities.description: I want a smart, sales-oriented messaging system that blends automation with the personal touch of a live agent. The core functions are broad: it must respond to routine questions, guide visitors toward purchases, and handle leads or bookings smoothly—essentially everything from first contact through follow-up. My audience talks to us primarily through Instagram/Facebook DMs, WhatsApp, and Telegram, so the solution has to work seamlessly on those channels. A well-trained bot should carry the conversation most of the time, but I need an easy way for a human operator to step in whenever the discussion becomes complex or high-value. I expect you to design, build, and deploy the chatbot, wire it into the chosen social platforms, and set up whatever hand-off workflow keeps the experience frictionless. If you have preferred frameworks—Dialogflow, ManyChat, BotPress, Twilio, etc.—feel free to recommend the best fit; scalability and clear analytics are priorities. Deliverables: • Conversational flow diagrams and copy tailored for support, promotion, and lead capture. • A fully configured bot that runs on Instagram/Facebook Messenger plus WhatsApp and Telegram. • Agent-takeover mechanism with alerts and an interface my team can use instantly. • Short onboarding guide or video so staff know when and how to jump in. I will review the project once the system can: 1. Resolve common FAQs without human help. 2. Push at least one promotional offer in a natural way during each relevant chat. 3. Transfer to a live agent within 10 seconds when the bot is asked to. If this sounds like your kind of build, let’s talk timeline and get started.

opportunities.title: Forgiveness & Peace Awareness Campaign
opportunities.description: I would like to launch a community-wide awareness campaign that puts forgiveness, peaceful living and basic respect for people and our shared environment at the center of daily conversation. The goal is to reach everyone—students, parents, local residents, leaders—so the material must be inclusive, easy to share and adaptable to different neighbourhood settings. What I need from you is a full campaign package: a clear strategy that explains the core message of forgiveness and peaceful coexistence, a memorable slogan "LOVE YOURSELF AND YOU WILL BE ABLE TO LOVE ALL!", visual assets for print and social media, and a simple rollout plan that local volunteers can follow. If you have experience designing community posters, short video scripts, radio spots or social-media challenges, please let me know; the more varied our touch-points, the better. Deliverables (all editable files preferred): • Campaign strategy brief with timeline • Key message guide and slogan options • Poster/flyer designs (A4 and A3) • Social-media graphics sized for Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp • One-minute video or storyboard concept for quick sharing • Outline for a small kick-off event that encourages open, honest dialogue Success for me is a set of materials that ordinary community members can pick up, understand at a glance and immediately use to spread the idea that forgiving others and living peacefully are choices we make together. If you are passionate about positive social change and can translate that into clear, compelling visuals and words, I look forward to working with you.

opportunities.title: Industrial / Product Designer Needed — Premium 3D-Printed Table Lamps (FDM / Parametric CAD)
opportunities.description: I am building a premium table-lamp brand in Saudi Arabia. The lamps will use ready-made electrical bases with E27 lamp holders, while the decorative lamp bodies/shades will be manufactured by professional FDM 3D-printing services in Riyadh. I am looking for a talented Industrial/Product Designer who can create original sculptural and manufacturable products, not only photorealistic renders. The design language will include ribbed, twisted, geometric, architectural, arabesque and translucent forms. A strong sense of premium home-product aesthetics is essential. You should have real experience designing parts for FDM printing and understand wall thickness, tolerances, overhangs, supports, print orientation, part splitting, assembly and material efficiency. The lamp will use a standardized mechanical interface around an E27 shade-ring holder. The current approximately 42 mm dimension is provisional; final dimensions will be supplied from measurements of the actual base sample. Required final deliverables: editable native/parametric CAD source; STEP where appropriate; watertight STL/3MF; interface dimensions and tolerances; recommended wall thickness; printing orientation/support guidance; approximate slicer material/time estimate; and revisions after the first physical prototype. Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino/Grasshopper or equivalent professional workflows are welcome. Blender is also welcome when combined with a reliable workflow for precise, manufacturable geometry. Please send 3–5 examples of physical products you personally designed, preferably designs that were actually 3D printed. Show photographs of printed prototypes when available. Lamp, furniture, home décor, lighting or consumer-product experience is especially relevant. This is a long term cooperation and if successfully tested demand, this would probably be 20+ 3d designs. All accepted commercial designs must be original and delivered with agreed exclusive commercial IP rights. Please state your hourly rate and your preferred fixed fee per production-ready lamp model.

opportunities.title: AI Telegram Support Chatbot
opportunities.description: I need an AI-powered customer-support chatbot that lives on Telegram and uses the OpenAI GPT API for natural, context-aware conversations. The bot’s primary job is to answer questions pulled from a prepared knowledge base, gather any missing customer details, and, when it reaches the edge of its knowledge, quietly alert a human agent in a private chat so the agent can step in from within Telegram. Core expectations • Real-time messaging with full conversation history so the model keeps context between turns. • Easy-to-tune behaviour: I want to adjust tone, fallback thresholds, and knowledge-base content without redeploying code. A lightweight web or CLI admin panel is fine as long as it’s clear and secure. • Structured data capture: name, e-mail, order ID, or other fields saved to a small support-request table (PostgreSQL or similar) that I can export. • Smooth agent hand-off: when escalation is triggered, the bot privately pings a predefined staff account, then stays silent while the human replies through Telegram. • Production-ready code—Python or Node.js—well modularised, commented, and delivered via Git. Include setup scripts, environment templates, and deployment notes for a VPS or Docker container. • Reliability and scale: graceful error handling, retry logic around both Telegram Bot API and OpenAI calls, and basic rate-limit awareness. Please show one or two live or past Telegram bots you built—especially anything that calls OpenAI or maintains multi-turn context—so I can gauge style and robustness. Once we agree on scope, I’ll provide the knowledge-base content and agent credentials, then we can break delivery into milestones: initial MVP bot, admin tools, final polish & deployment.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40835855, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 750 - 1,500.

This gives both sides a chance to see how we communicate and work together. I'm more interested in finding the **right person for long-term collaboration** than receiving a large number of generic proposals.

opportunities.title: Contractor AI Onboarding Integration Developer
opportunities.description: Outwrk.Ai sells an AI lead-response system to home-service contractors. It texts back every new lead within a minute, books appointments, follows up on estimates, revives old leads, requests reviews, and runs ads, with a dashboard that tracks results through to the paid job. We're looking for a developer to own onboarding each new client onto our existing platform (Node app on Railway, Twilio, Claude for AI replies, GitHub with a PR-based deploy). For each client that means: registering their A2P 10DLC texting brand and campaign in Twilio, including the privacy and SMS-terms pages carriers require on their website setting up their phone number with missed-call forwarding connecting or creating their CRM, usually free HubSpot, with a standard pipeline and fields that tie every lead to its final payment wiring their lead sources (website forms, chat, missed calls, and new connectors for Meta lead ads, Google Local Services Ads and email-notified lead sites) into our bot configuring their scripts, calendar, alerts and follow-up campaigns, then testing everything end to end before go-live The work has to follow texting-consent rules strictly, keep client data in accounts the client owns, and keep keys out of the code. A typical onboarding should take three to four weeks. The first one also includes building the reusable connectors and writing a step-by-step playbook so every future client can be onboarded from a checklist.

opportunities.title: Teleoperador B2B para Restaurante Ibiza
opportunities.description: Somos Carpe Diem, un restaurante y pizzería con servicio de delivery en Ibiza. Buscamos un/a teleoperador/a freelance con experiencia en llamadas comerciales B2B y residencia en España. El proyecto consistirá en: 1. Investigar y crear una lista de 50 empresas cercanas al restaurante (aproximadamente a 10 minutos en coche) utilizando información empresarial pública. Esta lista deberá especificar empresa, sector, teléfono, email o WhatsApp comercial, enlace de Google Maps o página web. 2. Preparar la lista completa en un documento colaborativo de Google Sheets. 3. Realizar llamadas comerciales B2B exclusivamente a las empresas aprobadas, utilizando un número visible español. 4. Presentar brevemente "Carpe Diem" y nuestras ofertas para empresas: comidas para empleados, delivery, promociones especiales y menús para grupos (incluyendo opciones especiales como menús navideños). 5. Detectar interés y solicitar autorización para enviar información adicional por WhatsApp o email. Requisitos del perfil buscado: - Residencia en España. - Dominio natural del español y buena dicción. - Experiencia previa en telemarketing, ventas telefónicas o campañas B2B. - Voz agradable, segura y profesional. - Habilidad organizativa y manejo competente de Google Sheets. - Posibilidad de emitir factura. - Se valorará experiencia específica con restaurantes, servicio de delivery o captación de empresas. Notas adicionales: Las llamadas serán realizadas dentro del horario comercial español en bloques de aproximadamente 2–3 horas diarias durante varios días.

opportunities.title: Chatbot WhatsApp Estado Pedidos
opportunities.description: Necesito poner en marcha un agente automático en WhatsApp que atienda a mis clientes las 24 h respondiendo únicamente consultas sobre el estado de sus pedidos, envíos o reservas. Toda la información debe leerse en tiempo real desde mi tienda en línea, de modo que el cliente escriba su número de pedido y el bot devuelva la última actualización disponible sin intervención humana. Algunas referencias técnicas: • El e-commerce está montado en (indícamelo al iniciar la propuesta: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento u otro) y dispongo de acceso API/WEBHOOK para extraer datos de órdenes y tracking. • El canal de WhatsApp Business ya está verificado y activo; faltaría la integración vía Cloud API, Twilio o la solución que sugieras. • Mensajería en español; si la arquitectura lo permite, que sea multilenguaje a futuro. Entrego credenciales y textos de respuesta preferidos; tú te encargas de: 1. Conectar la fuente de datos de la tienda. 2. Configurar el flujo donde el bot reconozca el número de pedido, valide al cliente y devuelva estado, link de tracking y fecha estimada. 3. Pruebas de estrés básicas para asegurar disponibilidad 24/7. 4. Manual breve (PDF o vídeo corto) para que mi equipo pueda modificar respuestas o volver a desplegar en caso de cambios. Criterio de aceptación: antes de liberar el hito quiero ingresar un pedido de prueba y recibir en WhatsApp la respuesta automática correcta en menos de 5 segundos.

opportunities.title: Vidéo animée ours-chouette romantique
opportunities.description: Je souhaite offrir à mon conjoint·e un petit film animé qui accompagne une chanson dont je possède les droits. L’idée : un ours et une chouette humanoïde dansent tendrement, comme un hommage à nos 35 ans de mariage. Style recherché • Doux et romantique, façon conte illustré (couleurs pastel, traits soignés, atmosphère chaleureuse). • La vidéo ne raconte pas toute notre histoire ; elle se concentre sur une seule scène de danse symbolisant notre longue relation. Ce que je fournirai • Le fichier audio de la chanson (durée : longueur exacte précisée dès le lancement). • Quelques photos de nous pour inspirer les expressions et la complicité du couple. Ce que j’attends de vous 1. Story-board simple validé avec moi avant l’animation définitive. 2. Animation 2D ou 3D au rendu “dessin animé illustré” fluide et poétique. 3. Synchronisation précise avec le rythme de la chanson. 4. Montage final en HD (1920×1080), fichier mp4 prêt à projeter, plus une version sans musique au besoin. 5. Droit d’usage complet pour un partage familial (pas de diffusion commerciale prévue). Idéalement, vous maîtrisez Toon Boom, TVPaint, After Effects, Blender Grease Pencil ou tout autre outil adapté au style conte illustré, et vous avez déjà animé des séquences de danse. Merci de joindre à votre proposition : • Un ou deux exemples de travaux d’animation “romantiques”/“conte” proches du rendu souhaité. • Votre délai estimé du storyboard au rendu final. Au plaisir de collaborer pour donner vie à cette petite parenthèse enchantée !

opportunities.title: Experienced Tailings & Slurry System Engineer Needed
opportunities.description: I am planning a full engineering study for a tailings/slurry handling project and need everything documented to a standard that satisfies both internal management and external regulators. The assignment starts with gathering the operating data I will provide—flow rates, solids content, elevation profile—then moves through hydraulic and geotechnical calculations, pipeline and pump sizing, and culminates in a clear engineering package. The final package must include: • A concise design brief that explains the governing assumptions and equations • Annotated drawings in AutoCAD (or compatible) showing pipe routes, pump stations, and deposition areas • An Excel or similar calculation file so the numbers remain transparent and easy to audit • A short risk and operability commentary highlighting wear, blockage, and containment issues Requirements: • Proven experience in slurry delivery systems, tailings backfill systems, and paste plants (minimum 10 years) • Ability to start immediately • Commitment for four months • Hourly rate negotiable but proven expertise is non-negotiable If you already use tools such as FLAC, ANSYS, or Pipeline Studio, feel free to leverage them—just provide native files with a PDF summary so I can review without extra licenses. Draft deliverables are expected two weeks after kick-off; I will review and return comments within three days. A single revised submission should then close the project.

opportunities.title: Luxury Brand Automation Platform

Please highlight the experience that best proves you can take a concept from planning to post-launch refinement; I’m less interested in lengthy portfolios than in concise, relevant wins that mirror this brief. opportunities.title: Automated Nifty Options Trading Bot
opportunities.description: I’m ready to move my manual Nifty 50 options strategy onto full-scale automation inside the 5paisa platform. All of my entry and exit rules are already written out, complete with indicator conditions, price levels, and time-based filters, so I don’t need help designing the logic—only translating it into code that places live trades automatically. Here’s the workflow I expect: • The bot connects to my 5paisa account via their official APIs, pulls market data in real time, and continuously evaluates each rule set. • When every entry condition aligns, it must place the correct call or put order instantly with predefined quantity, stop-loss, and target parameters. No manual approval windows. • Once in a position, the code has to monitor exit criteria (indicator cross, price touch, time cut-off, etc.) and close or modify orders just as precisely. • Every action—signal met, order placed, order modified, order closed—should be logged to a simple dashboard and saved to a CSV/DB for later analysis. • If there’s a connectivity or API error, the bot must fail safely and alert me so positions aren’t left unmanaged. I’m comfortable using Python, so a clean, well-commented Python script (or small set of modules) would be perfect, but I’m open to another language if you can prove stability with 5paisa. Please incorporate back-test and paper-trade modes that rely on historical data or 5paisa’s sandbox before we switch the live flag. Deliverable: • Source code with setup guide • Sample config file where I can edit my indicator values, price thresholds, timings, and risk parameters • Brief screen-share or written walkthrough showing the bot running in paper-trade mode and then on a single live session Once the bot reliably mirrors my strategy end-to-end, I’ll green-light deployment on a VPS for 24×7 operation and release final approval.

opportunities.title: Consultor de Inteligencia de Negocios y Analítica de Clientes para ...
opportunities.description: YAVA Capital, una empresa mexicana de microfinanciamiento, busca un consultor externo especializado en Inteligencia de Negocios (Business Intelligence), Analítica de Clientes (Customer Analytics) y análisis estratégico de datos. El objetivo principal es transformar la información histórica y operativa de la empresa en inteligencia estratégica para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, comprender el comportamiento de los clientes, mejorar su retención y optimizar la rentabilidad. Se busca un profesional con pensamiento crítico, criterio financiero, curiosidad estadística y capacidad para descubrir patrones, anomalías y oportunidades no identificadas. No se busca únicamente un desarrollador de dashboards o un analista de reportes. Responsabilidades principales del consultor: 1. Analizar bases de datos históricas de clientes y operaciones crediticias. 2. Identificar patrones de comportamiento, permanencia, renovación y deserción. 3. Desarrollar modelos de segmentación demográfica, geográfica y comercial. 4. Investigar la relación entre adquisición de clientes, retención, compensaciones comerciales y crecimiento neto. 5. Identificar indicadores estratégicos que actualmente no se monitorean. 6. Diseñar un catálogo maestro de indicadores y alertas tempranas. 7. Detectar oportunidades de optimización de costos y rentabilidad. 8. Utilizar herramientas estadísticas e inteligencia artificial para profundizar en los análisis. 9. Presentar hallazgos y recomendaciones directamente a Dirección General. 10. Proponer nuevas líneas de investigación de manera autónoma. El perfil requerido es de una persona autónoma, analítica, proactiva y orientada a resultados, con capacidad para formular hipótesis, cuestionar información, identificar relaciones entre variables y convertir datos en recomendaciones empresariales. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Data Science Tamaño del proyecto: Grande
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante: C. (México). Publicó el anuncio en Workana (Hace 11 horas) con presupuesto de Más de USD 3.000.

opportunities.title: Editor TikTok para Clips Twitch
opportunities.description: Busco Clipero / Editor de Videos para Twitch Estoy buscando una persona que hable "español nativo" y se encargue de convertir los mejores momentos de mis streams de Twitch en videos cortos para TikTok, Instagram Reels y otras plataformas. Mi contenido se enfoca principalmente en videojuegos, humor, situaciones espontáneas y momentos divertidos durante los directos. ¿Qué necesito de ti? 1. Seleccionar los mejores momentos de mis streams y convertirlos en clips de aproximadamente 30 segundos. 2. Seguir como referencia el estilo de edición de los videos que ya he creado y mantener una línea similar. 3. Tener buen sentido del humor, entender el contexto de los clips y saber identificar el momento perfecto para generar una reacción o una carcajada. 4. Evitar las ediciones exageradas. Busco videos dinámicos, naturales y entretenidos, sin llenar cada segundo de efectos innecesarios. 5. Tener creatividad para identificar momentos que puedan funcionar bien en redes sociales. ¿Qué busco? - Español nativo (requisito indispensable). - Experiencia editando contenido para TikTok o Reels. - Conocimiento de Twitch y cultura gamer. - Buen criterio para seleccionar momentos virales. - Responsabilidad y disponibilidad para trabajar a largo plazo. Colaboración a largo plazo* Busco establecer una relación de trabajo estable con alguien que pueda crecer junto a mi canal y convertirse en parte del equipo de contenido. El primer mes será de prueba para evaluar la calidad del trabajo, la comunicación y si logramos conectar con el estilo de contenido que busco. Si te interesa, envíame algunos ejemplos de tus ediciones y tu tarifa.

opportunities.title: Realistic Ronaldo Street Celebration Image
opportunities.description: I need a single, photo-realistic image of Cristiano Ronaldo celebrating after scoring a goal in a gritty street-football setting. Think of his trademark “Siu!” moment—energy, motion, and emotion frozen in high detail—only this time the backdrop is an urban court with worn asphalt, cage fencing, and dramatic evening lights instead of a stadium. Please render the scene so it feels believable: realistic skin texture, accurate kit details, natural crowd blur from onlookers, and ambient city lighting. Subtle motion effects (flying dust, a slightly blurred ball rolling away) are welcome if they enhance realism without looking overly processed. Deliverables • One high-resolution RGB image (minimum 4000 px on the longest side) in layered PSD or TIFF and a flattened PNG/JPEG for quick preview • All external assets, brushes, or textures must be license-cleared or self-created I’ll approve the work once the likeness, lighting consistency, and overall street-football atmosphere match real-world photography. If you normally work in Blender, Maya, Photoshop, or a photorealistic AI pipeline, mention that so I understand your process.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40835630, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Spa-Luxe Gym Area Design
opportunities.description: I am refreshing my gym’s front-of-house into a calm, spa-like retreat and need a complete interior concept for the reception desk with waiting lounge, adjacent bathrooms, fully equipped changing rooms, and a small massage room. The atmosphere must feel premium yet immediately relaxing the moment members step through the door—think warm natural stone, soft indirect lighting, muted tones, and refined textures that whisper luxury rather than shout it. What I need from you is a cohesive design package that shows how all four zones flow together visually and functionally. Please include: • Scaled floor plan and furniture layout • 3D renders or walkthroughs that capture lighting mood and material finishes • A mood board with colour palette, textures, and reference imagery • Fixture, fitting, and material specifications (tiles, counters, lighting, hardware) available in common international catalogues • Basic MEP notes where special spa or changing-room requirements apply I work best with clear milestones—initial concept, revised layout, then final visuals and specs—so indicate how you’d break those down. Software is your choice (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, 3ds Max, or similar) as long as I receive editable source files plus high-resolution exports. If you have previous hospitality, spa, or boutique fitness design experience, do let me see it; that aesthetic alignment is key. Looking forward to turning the first hello at my gym into an indulgent, stress-melting welcome.

opportunities.title: Querétaro - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 8
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Querétaro. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.

opportunities.title: Production-Ready Plastic Seat CAD Drawing
opportunities.description: Both files provide a production-ready A3 landscape engineering drawing (HCP-161054-01, Rev. B) of the Kunststoffschale (Sitzwanne) for review and direct tooling edits in AutoCAD or SolidWorks: • Orthographic Views, Sections & Detail Call-Outs: Includes the right-side view (Seitenansicht rechts), front view (Frontansicht), rear view (Rückansicht), and top view (Draufsicht), paired with full cross-sections (Schnitt A–A and Schnitt B–B) and enlarged detail call-outs (Detail C – Befestigung Frontplatte and Detail D – Handgriff). • Dimensions, Tolerances & GD&T: Specifies linear dimensions (1,220 × 780 × 620 mm, 640 mm inner seat width, 430 mm seat depth, 240 mm seat height, 120 mm front lip) with plastic-specific tolerances (DIN 16742 TG6 / ISO 2768-c), primary mounting Datums A, B, and C, and true-position (⌖ Ø1.0) call-outs on the mounting hole patterns. • Material & Plastic Manufacturing Notes: Includes the Technische Daten specification table (5–8 mm wall thickness, UV-stabilized GFK/ABS, RAL 9016 finish, ≤ 18 kg target weight) alongside shop-floor notes covering minimum ≥ 2.0° draft angles, R ≥ 3.0 mm internal radii, VDI 3400 Ref. 27 / gelcoat surface finishes, CNC edge trimming, and shrinkage allowances. • Editable CAD Layers (.DXF): Organized into dedicated layers (VISIBLE, HIDDEN, CENTER, DIMENSIONS, GDT, TEXT, and BORDER) at 1:1 millimeter model-space units inside a 1:10 A3 sheet frame. If you'd like to refine the drawings after reviewing the native 3D CAD file, let me know: • The exact mounting hole coordinates (X/Y/Z), hole diameters, or threaded insert specs from your 3D model • Which primary production method you select (thermoformed ABS, injection molding, or GFK composite layup) so I can tailor the shrinkage and surface finish notes exclusively to that process

If you'd like to refine the drawings after reviewing the native 3D CAD file, let me know: • The exact mounting hole coordinates (X/Y/Z), hole diameters, or threaded insert specs from your 3D model • Which primary production method you select (thermoformed ABS, injection molding, or GFK composite layup) so I can tailor the shrinkage and surface finish notes exclusively to that process"

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Plataforma de Contenido de Video con Ia para Redes So...
opportunities.description: Buscamos un desarrollador con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial para crear una plataforma integral que automatice la creación, edición y publicación de videos en redes sociales. Esta solución innovadora permitirá a los usuarios optimizar su estrategia de contenido de video de manera eficiente y escalable. Las funcionalidades clave que deberá incluir la plataforma son: - Generación automática de videos utilizando IA: Esto abarca la creación de guiones, la selección de imágenes, la generación de voces, la adición de subtítulos y la edición completa del video. - Automatización de la publicación de contenido: La plataforma debe ser capaz de publicar videos de forma automática en las principales redes sociales como Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, entre otras. - Programación y gestión de calendario de contenido: Herramientas para programar publicaciones con antelación y gestionar un calendario editorial completo. - Administración de múltiples cuentas y perfiles: Posibilidad de gestionar varias cuentas y perfiles de redes sociales desde una única interfaz centralizada. - Dashboard de monitoreo y análisis: Un panel de control intuitivo para monitorear el rendimiento de las publicaciones, visualizar métricas clave y analizar los resultados obtenidos. - Gestión automatizada de procesos: La plataforma debe gestionar de forma autónoma los procesos de generación y publicación de contenido. Es fundamental que la solución sea escalable y permita integraciones fluidas con diferentes proveedores de IA y APIs de redes sociales para asegurar su adaptabilidad y crecimiento futuro. Se valorará altamente la experiencia previa en el desarrollo de plataformas SaaS, conocimientos en IA generativa, automatización de workflows y procesamiento de video. Los interesados deben presentar su experiencia en proyectos similares, una propuesta técnica detallada, los tiempos estimados para el desarrollo y el presupuesto requerido. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Inteligencia Artificial Tamaño del proyecto: Medio

opportunities.title: ¿Sabes convertir una llamada en una venta? Buscamos experiencia rea...
opportunities.description: Queremos conocer a profesionales que sepan escuchar, generar confianza y cerrar una venta por teléfono. Nos interesa lo que puedes demostrar en una conversación, además de lo que figure en tu currículum. dos requisitos que no son negociables 1. Haber vendido por teléfono a clientes de España. Debes poder explicar qué vendías, a quién y cuál era tu responsabilidad en el cierre. Valoramos especialmente la venta a empresas y autónomos. 2. Voz clara, acento neutro, excelente dicción y español fluido. La comunicación se comprobará en una entrevista y una simulación. qué esperamos de ti que sepas abrir una llamada en frío con naturalidad, localizar a la persona que decide, hacer preguntas útiles y explicar una propuesta sin recitar un texto. Que puedas resolver objeciones, presentar el precio, pedir el cierre y organizar el seguimiento cuando el cliente necesite tiempo. Buscamos venta real: haber atendido llamadas o agendado citas, por sí solo, no cubre este puesto. También necesitamos manejo de CRM, registro de las gestiones y disponibilidad en horario comercial español. El trabajo es remoto: ordenador propio, auriculares con buen micrófono, conexión estable y un lugar silencioso. Cómo será la colaboración fijo más comisiones, formación inicial, herramientas y material de apoyo. Buscamos continuidad. Explicaremos el servicio durante el primer contacto y acordaremos condiciones y objetivos antes de comenzar. Cómo vamos a elegir realizaremos una entrevista y un ejercicio breve de llamada con situaciones comerciales ficticias, sin llamar a clientes reales. Evaluaremos voz, escucha, explicación, respuesta a objeciones y cierre. La experiencia indicada deberá poder explicarse con ejemplos concretos. al presentarte adjunta tu currículum y responde brevemente: • ¿qué vendiste por teléfono en españa y durante cuánto tiempo? • ¿a empresas, autónomos o particulares? ¿cerrabas tú la contratación? • ¿qué objetivo tenías y qué resultados obtenías? sin datos confidenciales. • ¿Qué CRM y programas de llamadas utilizabas? • ¿Qué horario de España puedes cubrir y cuándo podrías empezar? Si Workana lo permite, añade una presentación de voz de 30 a 60 segundos. El proceso se coordinará por esta plataforma. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: Plastic Part Manufacturing Drawings for eTriBike
opportunities.description: I already have a complete 3D CAD model of my plastic part and now need clear, production-ready drawings created from it. Your task is to turn the existing file into fully detailed manufacturing drawings that a factory can work from without further clarification. What I will supply • The native 3D model/CAD file in its current format • Key functional notes and target dimensions where critical What I need back • Properly laid-out 2D drawings showing orthographic views, sections, and any necessary detail call-outs • Dimensions, tolerances, and GD&T where appropriate • Material and finish notes suitable for common plastic production methods • Files delivered in PDF for easy review and in an editable CAD format (DWG or native) for tooling revisions down the line I am happy to answer process-specific questions once you have reviewed the model so the drawings line up with whichever manufacturing route proves best. If you have experience preparing documentation for plastics—whether for injection molding, CNC, or additive—please let me know; that background will help ensure the drawings anticipate draft angles, shrinkage, and other practical factors. Fast turnaround and accuracy are important to me. If this sounds like a straightforward fit, please tell me which CAD platform you will use and send a brief outline of your approach.

opportunities.title: Enhance FoodShare Donation Platform
opportunities.description: # FoodShare – Turning Surplus Food into Hope! **Every meal matters. Every small act of kindness counts. ** Food waste is a major global challenge, while many people still struggle to access food. With this thought, I developed **FoodShare**, a web-based platform designed to connect food donors with people who need food. ### Project Overview FoodShare allows individuals and organisations to share surplus food with recipients, making food donation easier, more accessible, and better organised. ### Key Features - User Registration and Secure Login. - Role-Based Access for Donors and Recipients. - Add and Manage Food Donations. - Browse Available Food Donations. - Request Food from Donors. - Location-Based Food Discovery. - Interactive Maps for Pickup Locations. - Manage Donation Availability and Status. - Responsive and User-Friendly Interface. - Database Integration for Managing Users and Donations. ### Technology Stack - **Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap. - **Backend:** Python, Flask. - **Database:** MySQL. - **Additional Tools:** PyMySQL, Leaflet Maps, Geolocation API, Git, GitHub. - **Deployment:** Render. ### Key Learnings - Full Stack Web Application Development. - Python Flask Backend Development. - MySQL Database Design and Integration. - Authentication and Session Management. - CRUD Operations and API Development. - Location-Based Services Integration. - Real-World Problem-Solving and Deployment. ### Project Links **Live Demo:** https://foodshare-81o9.onrender.com/ **GitHub:** https://github.com/chaudhari2004/FoodShare ### My Vision I believe technology is most powerful when it solves real-world problems. FoodShare is my initiative to explore how web technology can help reduce food waste, encourage food sharing, and create a more responsible community. **Built with Python, creativity, and a purpose to make a difference! **

opportunities.title: Hyper-Realistic Songbird 3D Render
opportunities.description: I want a single, photorealistic 8-k render created in Unreal Engine 5 that captures a kingfisher perched on a moss-covered branch under gentle morning sunlight. The image must show razor-sharp detail on the bird’s eye and beak, lifelike feather textures, and a softly blurred bokeh forest background. Alongside the kingfisher hero shot, I also need two quick alternates: • a European robin rendered in the same forest setting • a goldfinch variant posed among wildflowers in a sunny meadow Key requirements • Unreal Engine 5 path-traced lighting or equivalent high-fidelity workflow • True-to-life feather grooming and micro-detail normal maps • Natural colour grading; no oversaturation • Final outputs: 8-k PNG (or EXR) plus the complete UE5 project files so I can adjust camera angles later Please keep geometry efficient, supply all texture sources, and ensure file naming is tidy. If you have previous bird-oriented renders, share them so I can gauge realism before we start.

opportunities.title: Plataforma Repuestos y Talleres Chile
opportunities.description: Quiero desarrollar una plataforma web que conecte casas de repuestos automotrices con talleres mecánicos en Chile. El objetivo es que los talleres puedan buscar repuestos, comparar ofertas de distintas casas de repuestos y solicitar pedidos sin tener que desplazarse físicamente. La plataforma debe funcionar desde computadores y teléfonos celulares Integración automática con los inventarios de las tiendas. Búsqueda avanzada por VIN. Catálogo completo de compatibilidad de vehículos. Integración con Uber, Rappi u otros servicios de reparto. Pagos en línea. Geolocalización Es importante que: - La plataforma sea adaptable a celulares y computadores. - La base de datos esté bien organizada. - Los datos puedan exportarse. - El proyecto quede dentro de una cuenta de Bubble controlada por el propietario del negocio. - El propietario tenga acceso de administrador. - El desarrollo quede documentado para que otro programador pueda continuarlo. - Se utilicen herramientas y plugins cuyo costo recurrente esté claramente informado.

opportunities.title: Lead Generation Project – 10 Free-Trial Sign-Ups ($40 USD Fixed)
opportunities.description: We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded digital promoter to drive user sign-ups for a leading international audiobook platform. The goal is simple and straightforward: generate 10 verified free-trial sign-ups within 1 month for a fixed project payment of $40 USD ($4.00 USD per valid lead). About the Offer & How Sign-Up Works: • Users get a 30-day free trial with 3 audiobooks included, open to the general public worldwide. • Important (Full Transparency): Just like any major subscription service (such as Netflix or Spotify), the user must link a valid payment method to activate the free trial, though they are charged $0 upfront and can cancel anytime before the 30 days end at no cost. • Precisely because this verification step is required to prevent fake accounts, we offer a high payout of $4.00 USD per confirmed sign-up. Workflow, Timeline & Payment Structure (100% Guaranteed): This project has a 1-month timeframe and is divided into 2 clear milestones for mutual security: • Milestone 1 – Initial Test (3 leads = $12 USD – Must be completed within 1 week): We start with an initial test of 3 valid sign-ups. These first 3 leads must be completed within your first 7 days so we can verify your traffic quality and approve you to continue for the rest of the month. They count toward your 10-lead total. • Milestone 2 – Final Stage (7 leads = $28 USD): Delivery and validation of the remaining 7 verified sign-ups over the rest of the month to complete the 10-lead goal and unlock the full $40 USD payment. • Protected Payments: Each milestone is funded upfront in Freelancer escrow before starting that stage and released within 24 hours once the target is met and verified. • Transparent Tracking: You will receive a custom affiliate link with your own unique Sub-ID so your leads are tracked accurately and separately from anyone else's. Important Role Details & Quality Rules: • No Brand Access Required: I operate as an independent affiliate partner, so this role does not involve managing, posting on, or accessing official company social media accounts or websites. • How Top Freelancers Succeed: You will promote using your own channels, social networks, student/work groups, communities, or direct word-of-mouth with friends, family, and acquaintances. Simple, direct recommendations work fastest! • Results-Based Payment: Please note this is a milestone-based project paid upon verified sign-ups, not an hourly or fixed-salary role regardless of results. • Strict Quality Rule: All traffic must be 100% organic and genuine. Every user must sign up from their own internet connection or mobile data (sharing the same Wi-Fi network or IP address, VPNs, bots, giveaways, or incentivized traffic are strictly prohibited). Delivery & Validation Requirements: To validate each milestone and release the corresponding payment: 1. The sign-ups must show as approved in my affiliate dashboard under your unique Sub-ID link. 2. You must submit a brief Microsoft Word document stating the total number of leads generated in that stage and the methods used (word-of-mouth, social media, groups, etc.) to cross-check with the dashboard data. Performance Perks & Higher Volume Capacity: If you can reach more people and generate more than 10 leads per month, please state your monthly capacity directly in your proposal along with your adjusted bid amount (at $4.00 USD per valid lead). For example, if you can deliver 25 leads in a month, submit a bid for $100 USD and specify that target in your message. To Apply, Please Answer Briefly: 1. Which methods or channels will you use to get the sign-ups (word-of-mouth, personal network, groups, social media, etc.)? 2. Can you commit to completing the Milestone 1 test (first 3 valid leads) within 1 week (7 days), and the full 10 leads within 1 month? 3. Monthly Capacity & Bid: If you can generate more than 10 leads per month, how many can you commit to, and what is your total bid amount for the project based on that volume? We hire quickly and are looking for action-oriented people ready to start today! IMPORTANT NOTE – Fast-Delivery Bonus & Long-Term Perks: If you complete all 10 valid leads within 2 weeks (14 days) instead of the full month, you will receive an extra bonus commission on top of your $40 USD payout for delivering ahead of schedule! Additionally, based on your speed and traffic quality, we can establish guaranteed fixed monthly payments and higher commission rates for the following months.

opportunities.title: Dynamic TikTok Science Video Edits
opportunities.description: Produzco contenido científico para TikTok y Reels y necesito un editor que lo transforme en piezas cortas, ágiles y memorables. Yo te facilito todo el material en video o imágenes; tu misión será armar un formato vertical de 60-120 s, incorporar textos claros, efectos llamativos y música libre de derechos que mantenga el ritmo y la atención sin sacrificar el rigor científico. El estilo debe sentirse dinámico, con transiciones limpias, subtítulos legibles y motion graphics que destaquen datos clave. Busco creatividad para sincronizar cortes con la pista musical, aprovechar zooms, máscaras y pequeñas animaciones que refuercen conceptos. El primer video lo necesito listo cuanto antes, idealmente en las próximas semanas y seguiríamos con más de forma continua si el resultado encaja. Al finalizar cada pieza quiero el .mp4 final en 1080 × 1920 más el proyecto editable (Premiere, DaVinci o similar) para ajustes futuros. Si dominás estos recursos y tenés ejemplos similares, compartilos y avanzamos de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Automatización IA Respuestas Multicanal CRM
opportunities.description: Quiero construir un sistema que, a partir de nuestros historiales de conversación con clientes, sugiera respuestas inteligentes para los mensajes que ingresan tanto por correo electrónico como por WhatsApp. Flujo deseado • Cuando llega un mensaje, la IA genera una respuesta preliminar usando los chats previos como base de conocimiento. • Esa respuesta se muestra en una página web donde mi equipo puede leerla, editarla si hace falta y aprobarla antes de enviarla. • En horario laboral, la respuesta aprobada se envía automáticamente; fuera de horario no debe responder nada. Integración con WhatsApp • Cada correo entrante debe reenviarse también a nuestro número de WhatsApp para que, si lo preferimos, podamos contestar con un mensaje de voz. • El sistema debe transcribir ese audio y devolverlo al hilo de correo como texto formateado. Seguimiento de oportunidades Si un cliente no responde o la venta no se cierra, la plataforma enviará recordatorios automáticos que incluyen un descuento configurable para incentivar la compra. Requisitos técnicos clave – Canales obligatorios: correo electrónico y WhatsApp. – Motor de IA entrenado en nuestros chats históricos. – Panel web simple y rápido para aprobar cada mensaje. – Restricción de horario configurable. – Registro estilo CRM: conversación, estado, fecha del último recordatorio y resultado. Entregables mínimos 1. Código fuente completo y documentación de instalación. 2. Panel web funcional para vista previa y aprobación. 3. Conectores operativos a Gmail/IMAP y API de WhatsApp Business. 4. Lógica de follow-up con descuentos y control de horario. 5. Guía rápida para que mi equipo pueda ajustar prompts, descuentos y horarios sin depender de desarrollo.

proposal.body:
¡Hola Cliente J. V.! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con perfilación sensorial avalada por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **Creación de Video Inmobiliario Profesional con Intro Cómica y Diseñ...**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos con válvula desgasificadora).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado (humedad 10%-11.5%), café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🏅 **3. Calidad Garantizada**: Perfil dulce, limpio, notas a panela, melocotón y flor de café, libre de defectos primarios.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?
